stage: After viewed overview, before targeted rechecks; source titles exposed, no external ground-truth floorplan consulted

predictions.selected_hypothesis: Bedroom 1 and bathroom 1 are separate doors off a short common hall near the entry, not a private en-suite.
predictions.alternative: Bathroom 1 is reachable only through bedroom 1.
predictions.test_prediction: The 58–100 s route should leave the bedroom, return to hard-floor circulation and enter bathroom from the same short hall.
predictions.recheck_observation: 87–99 s returns from bedroom to hard-floor common hall and enters bathroom separately.

predictions.selected_hypothesis: Bedroom 2 has an internal dressing/closet approach to its own bathroom on the opposite side of living from bedroom 1.
predictions.alternative: The second bathroom is another common-hall bathroom.
predictions.test_prediction: The 117–160 s sequence should cross from living into bedroom 2 and show its closet/bath entry within that bedroom rather than returning to common circulation.
predictions.recheck_observation: 120–160 s shows bedroom entry, internal closet and bathroom; reverse view returns into bedroom.

predictions.selected_hypothesis: Laundry is a separate utility room off common living/entry circulation rather than either bedroom.
predictions.alternative: Laundry is within bedroom 2 or its closet.
predictions.test_prediction: The 164–180 s return should leave bedroom 2 and enter a separate common-area door before showing machines.
predictions.recheck_observation: 168–179 s leaves bedroom, returns to living and enters separate laundry doorway.

predictions.selected_hypothesis: Three bedrooms branch from a single narrow corridor beside living; the bathroom complex is reached from this corridor.
predictions.alternative: The bathroom is private to one bedroom and the bedroom sequence is stitched across separate hallways.
predictions.test_prediction: The 44–95 s route should repeatedly return to the same corridor, with matching trim and doorway order.
predictions.recheck_observation: Repeated corridor anchors support a shared bedroom corridor; bedroom edits prevent recovery of exact order. Bathroom also has access from bedroom 1.

predictions.selected_hypothesis: The bath includes a shared tub/toilet compartment between hall-side and bedroom-side vanity/access areas.
predictions.alternative: Only one standard bathroom exists, and reversed views give the impression of extra access.
predictions.test_prediction: The 60–85 s sequence should show whether the tub area has another doorway and whether its exit opens toward a bedroom.
predictions.recheck_observation: Two access/vanity areas share a tub compartment, but each outer area has its own toilet. The initial shared tub/toilet wording was wrong.

predictions.selected_hypothesis: Laundry is a rear utility passage beside the living fireplace, connecting to the deck.
predictions.alternative: Laundry is reached from the bedroom corridor independently of the fireplace door.
predictions.test_prediction: The 90–110 s sequence should tie utility room to the fireplace-side door and then to the exterior deck.
predictions.recheck_observation: 44–48 s kitchen view places utility beside refrigerator; 100–109 s shows utility and concrete patio. Fireplace-side deck connection was an incorrect join.

evaluation_limit: Six prospective source-consistency checks on two selected tours, not ground-truth floor-plan accuracy or a blinded benchmark.
